messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['We noticed that you recently made a request to shut down your email.', 'We regret having to terminate the account with HSBC.', 'If this purchase was made by the mistake, and you want to cancel the subscription, click the link under the subscription options in this message, and then change the password on your Apple account, supposedly it was stolen.', 'Description Unit price Qty Amount Online Number, 3 month subscription Item# 18.00 GBP 1 18.00 GBP', 'ITUNES STORE FAMILY MEMBERSHIP 1 YEAR | 08 AUGUST 2018']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
